---
title: Duplicate ids on blocks without annotations
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'Duplicate code cell id'
        negate: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'cell-id: "lst-b", annotations'
        -
          - 'cell-id: "lst-b-2"'
---

```{#lst-a .python}
a = 1
```

```{#lst-a .python}
b = 2
```

```{#lst-b .python}
c = 3  # <1>
```

1. Annotated.
